// About

From logs to layouts

I'm a BCA graduate who started out in cybersecurity — three months deep in an internship before stepping into a SOC Analyst role at an engineering company, where I spend my days watching logs and hunting for what shouldn't be there.

Somewhere along the way I picked up development too. I've built an e-commerce storefront, a phishing-detection recon tool, and a vulnerability lab from the ground up, and I front-ended a ride-booking app end to end.

When I'm not in Splunk or a codebase, I'm designing posters or cutting video. Different tools, same instinct: figure out how something works, then make it better.
